rationale: The first versioned relevance corpus for OpenbookLM core (EP-001, US-001). It exists to make retrieval, grounding and citation changes measurable instead of anecdotal. Every notebook, source, chunk and query is synthetic and written for this repository; nothing here is derived from a production account, conversation or document. Coverage is stratified over the eight failure modes the PRD names, and a locked holdout split keeps two cases per category out of reach of tuning work.

changelog.summary: Initial corpus: 3 notebooks, 14 sources, 41 chunks, 40 labeled queries, 5 per category, 24 train and 16 holdout. Tenant-isolation probes point at the nb-legal sources so that a cross-notebook retrieval is a labeled failure rather than an unnoticed one.
